scripts.start: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND "bash backend/scripts/iniciar-local.sh" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5173 --strictPort"
scripts.stop: bash -c 'for port in 8080 5173; do pid=$(lsof -tiTCP:$port -sTCP:LISTEN); if [ -n "$pid" ]; then parent=$(ps -o ppid= -p "$pid" | tr -d " "); kill $parent $pid 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done'
